license_required.quote: nor shall any person so practice until such person has obtained a license from the Department of Public Health after meeting the requirements of this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: obtained a license from the Department of Public Health after meeting the requirements of this chapter

degree_required.quote: he or she received the degree of D.P.M., Doctor of Podiatric Medicine

accrediting_body.value: Connecticut Board of Examiners in Podiatry with the consent of the Commissioner of Public Health
accrediting_body.quote: diploma or other certificate of graduation from an accredited school or college of chiropody or podiatry approved by the Connecticut Board of Examiners in Podiatry with the consent of the Commissioner of Public Health

kind.quote: receiving practical training in podiatry in a residency program in an accredited hospital facility which program is accredited by the Council on Podiatric Education

exams.name: Department of Public Health podiatry examination
exams.notes: Subjects include anatomy, physiology, dermatology, bacteriology, chemistry, pharmacy, theory and practice of podiatry
exams.quote: The Department of Public Health shall hold examinations under the supervision of the board at least once each year

exams.name: National Board of Podiatry Examiners certificate
exams.notes: May be accepted in lieu of written examination
exams.quote: The Department of Public Health may accept a certificate issued by the National Board of Podiatry Examiners or the license of any state board of podiatry examiners

interval_years.quote: See Sec. 19a-88 re annual renewal of licenses.

available.quote: The Department of Public Health may accept a certificate issued by the National Board of Podiatry Examiners or the license of any state board of podiatry examiners or duly authorized licensing agency of any state in the United States or in the District of Columbia, in lieu of the written examination

requirements.value: Applicant must have graduated from a recognized school, the other state must maintain standards equal to or higher than Connecticut, and applicant must show good professional standing; no license issued if disciplinary action is pending
requirements.quote: such state board or licensing agency maintains standards for licensure determined by the department to be equal to or higher than those of this state, and that he has presented to said department evidence showing him to be of good professional standing

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto, in accordance with section 20-54.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto, in accordance with section 20-54.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, administer and dispense drugs and controlled substances in schedule II, III, IV or V
drug_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine, licensed pursuant to this chapter may prescribe, administer and dispense drugs and controlled substances in schedule II, III, IV or V, in accordance with section 21a-252, in connection with the practice of podiatric medicine.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "ankle" means the distal metaphysis and epiphysis of the tibia and fibula, the articular cartilage of the distal tibia and distal fibula, the ligaments that connect the distal metaphysis and epiphysis of the tibia and fibula and the talus, and the portions of skin, subcutaneous tissue, fascia, muscles, tendons and nerves at or below the level of the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae.

amputation_authorized.quote: Podiatric surgery shall not include amputation of the leg or foot other than from the transmetatarsal level to the toes.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatric surgery requiring an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: A licensed podiatrist may independently engage in the surgical treatment of the ankle, including the surgical treatment of the anatomical structures of the ankle

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Graduation on or after June 1, 2006, from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery that was accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education, or its successor organization, at the time of graduation

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: "Podiatric medicine" includes treatment of local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot and ankle, in accordance with section 20-54.

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery
board_certification_body.quote: board qualified or certified by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery or the American Board of Podiatric Medicine, or said boards' successor organizations

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: Each person licensed to practice podiatric medicine under the provisions of section 20-54 or 20-57 who provides direct patient care services shall maintain professional liability insurance or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice.

total_ankle_replacement_authorized.quote: a licensed podiatrist who has provided documentation to the Department of Public Health of meeting the requirements set forth in subdivision (1) or (2) of subsection (c) of section 20-54 may apply to a hospital in the state for privileges to perform total ankle replacement surgery at such hospital

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: shall not treat tibial pilon fractures

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit or restrict the sale or fitting of corrective, orthopedic or arch-supporting shoes or commercial foot appliances by retail merchants
